description: 3-stage mass assignment via Mongoose Mixed type + markModified: (1) add Schema.Types.Mixed metadata field to User model, (2) add PATCH /v1/users/:id/metadata using Object.assign + save — changes don't persist because Mongoose can't detect Mixed mutations, (3) fix persistence by adding markModified('metadata') before save — now arbitrary user-controlled data persists including role escalation fields.
